applications.name: Getright demo
applications.description: An isolated local fixture for verifying the UAT loop.

applications.name: Virtual Company
applications.description: Business workflows using isolated company data.

tests.title: Create, save and reopen a note
tests.purpose: Verify the runner, persistence checks, evidence capture and human review using a disposable fixture.
tests.reviewQuestion: Is the save confirmation clear, and does the note remain easy to find?

steps.title: Open the isolated note workspace
steps.expected: An empty editor is available for this run's fixture ID.

steps.title: Write a note
steps.expected: The title and text can be entered.

steps.title: Save the note
steps.expected: A successful save confirmation appears.

steps.title: Reload and reopen
steps.expected: The saved title and text are preserved after reload.

tests.title: Create and save a document
tests.purpose: Create a document in an isolated WriterApp instance, save and reopen it.
tests.reviewQuestion: Is creating and saving a document clear and convenient?

steps.title: Open the document library
steps.expected: The isolated workspace is visible.

steps.title: Create a document and enter unique text
steps.expected: The new document's editor accepts this run's unique fixture content.

steps.title: Save the document
steps.expected: Persistence succeeds and is visible to the user.

steps.title: Reload and reopen
steps.expected: The title and text are preserved.

tests.title: Generate a synopsis
tests.purpose: Generate a synopsis from known fixture text with controlled AI responses.
tests.reviewQuestion: Are progress, results and recovery options understandable?

steps.title: Generate and review a synopsis
steps.expected: A result or actionable error appears without losing source text.

tests.title: Edit and reopen an existing document
tests.purpose: Verify edits survive navigation and reload.
tests.reviewQuestion: Can you confidently leave and return to your work?

steps.title: Edit, navigate away and reopen
steps.expected: The revised content is retained.

tests.title: Share a document and accept an invitation
tests.purpose: Adapt the existing sharing-workspace.mjs fixture with explicit owner and recipient identities.
tests.reviewQuestion: Are document access and invitation actions clear?

steps.title: Invite and accept in isolated sessions
steps.expected: The recipient receives the intended access and private documents remain private.

tests.title: Recover from a failed save
tests.purpose: Use a controlled persistence failure to verify visible error and recovery.
tests.reviewQuestion: Is it clear what failed and how to retry without losing work?

steps.title: Fail a save, restore service and retry
steps.expected: Unsaved edits remain available and the retry persists them.

tests.title: Create a test company and save permissions
tests.purpose: Create a synthetic company, save draft-email permissions, reopen it and verify owner access and company isolation.
tests.reviewQuestion: Can the intended user complete this business workflow confidently?

steps.title: Open test-company creation
steps.expected: The isolated owner can create a synthetic company.

steps.title: Create and select a company
steps.expected: A unique test company is created with external actions blocked.

steps.title: Save draft-only permissions
steps.expected: Draft permission is saved; sending remains disabled.

steps.title: Reopen and verify isolation
steps.expected: Permissions persist, the reference company is unchanged, and the employee cannot access owner controls.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Verify cash balance and source
tests.purpose: Verify that Laura answers a bounded cash question from authoritative company evidence.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: a fresh, disconnected test company with an authorized Finance reader and one SEK cash account. Use an explicit as-of time of 2026-10-15T10:00:00Z and seed authoritative cash evidence for 12,345.67 SEK as of that instant. Retain the source record ID and its in-app destination. Use scripted model responses for tool selection and synthesis, with the actual Finance read tool supplying the amounts.
tests.reviewQuestion: Can a Finance user verify the amount, timestamp, and underlying source in either language?

steps.title: Ask for the current cash balance and its source in English
steps.expected: Laura reports 12,345.67 SEK as of the fixture timestamp and shows a source link for the selected company.

steps.title: Ask the equivalent question in Swedish in a fresh conversation
steps.expected: The localized answer preserves the same amount, currency, timestamp, and source record.

steps.title: Follow the source link from each answer
steps.expected: Both links open the authorized company evidence, which matches the seeded source record and supports the reported amount and timestamp.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Clarify an ambiguous invoice lookup
tests.purpose: Verify that Laura asks for clarification when a reference has multiple accessible matches.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: a fresh, disconnected test company, an authorized Finance reader, and two accessible invoices numbered INV-1042-A and INV-1042-B. Give them distinct counterparties and totals, with INV-1042-A seeded at 1,250 SEK. The shorter reference INV-1042 should prompt clarification. Use a scripted model that leaves record resolution to the real Finance resolver.
tests.reviewQuestion: Does Laura make it clear which detail would distinguish the intended invoice?

steps.title: Ask for the total on invoice INV-1042 without a distinguishing detail
steps.expected: Laura requests clarification and makes no definitive claim about either invoice total or identity.

steps.title: Provide the full reference that identifies the intended invoice
steps.expected: Laura returns 1,250 SEK and links to the intended invoice only. The lookup leaves both invoice records unchanged.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Block cross-company invoice access
tests.purpose: Verify that an invoice ID cannot bypass company isolation in Laura's read flow.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: two fresh, disconnected test companies, A and B, each with a distinct invoice ID for INV-1042-A. Give B's invoice a unique synthetic counterparty and total. Use a Finance reader authorized only for A. Retain both IDs for assertions and use a scripted model so the real policy and lookup path evaluates the supplied ID.
tests.reviewQuestion: Does the response make the failed lookup understandable while keeping the other company private?

steps.title: As A's reader, look up A's invoice by its exact ID
steps.expected: Laura returns A's invoice and its authorized source link.

steps.title: From the same session, request B's invoice by its exact ID
steps.expected: The lookup is denied or returns no accessible match. B's counterparty, amount and source link are absent from the response and returned tool evidence.

steps.title: Check the selected company and the fixture records
steps.expected: The session remains in A, the foreign ID did not resolve to A's similarly numbered invoice, and neither invoice changed.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Recommend a category without changing the transaction
tests.purpose: Verify that an explicit recommendation request produces reviewable advice without applying it.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: a fresh, disconnected test company with a Finance operator authorized to recommend and eligible to request execution. Seed one uncategorized software-vendor transaction and an eligible Software category. Retain the original persisted transaction and category. Script the model to request a recommendation and configure deterministic recommendation evidence for Software.
tests.reviewQuestion: Can the operator distinguish the recommendation from a saved category and understand its rationale?

steps.title: Ask Laura to recommend a category for the exact transaction
steps.expected: Laura proposes Software, explains the evidence, and identifies the transaction. The result is presented as a recommendation awaiting a separate action.

steps.title: Reload the transaction and inspect action history
steps.expected: The original uncategorized state and saved transaction fields are preserved. No mutation, approval request, or posting was created by the recommendation.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Apply an independently approved change once
tests.purpose: Verify the pending approval boundary and idempotent execution of the approved action.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: a fresh, disconnected test company with separate authenticated requester and authorized approver sessions. Seed one uncategorized USD 250 transaction, an eligible Software category, and a USD 100 categorization approval threshold. Use a scripted model, the real approval and categorization services, and a trusted way to replay delivery for the same approval and inspect its durable effects.
tests.reviewQuestion: Can the requester and approver tell what is pending, exactly what was approved, and when it took effect?

steps.title: As the requester, ask Laura to set the category to Software and confirm the proposed action
steps.expected: One approval is pending for the exact transaction and category. The transaction remains uncategorized.

steps.title: As the independent approver, approve the retained request
steps.expected: The exact transaction becomes Software. The execution succeeds and its history links the requester, approver, approval, and resulting change.

steps.title: Redeliver the same approved continuation and reload the transaction
steps.expected: The category stays Software, with exactly one committed category update attributable to the approval and no second business effect.

tests.title: Finance Agent · Block approval after the target changes
tests.purpose: Verify that an approval for an earlier record version cannot overwrite a subsequent change.
tests.preconditions: Required fixture: a fresh, disconnected test company with separate authenticated requester and authorized approver sessions, an uncategorized USD 250 transaction, eligible Software and Travel categories, and a USD 100 categorization approval threshold. Use a scripted model and the real approval service. Provide a trusted fixture action that changes the target category after the request is recorded.
tests.reviewQuestion: Does the stale outcome explain why Laura needs a fresh review and preserve the intervening change?

steps.title: Request and confirm a change to Software, then retain the pending approval and target version
steps.expected: One approval is pending for the captured version. The transaction is still uncategorized.

steps.title: Change the transaction to Travel through the authorized fixture action
steps.expected: The transaction now shows Travel. The pending approval still refers to the original reviewed state.

steps.title: As the independent approver, attempt to approve the retained request
steps.expected: The continuation reports a stale target and requires fresh review. The intervening Travel category is preserved, with zero category updates attributable to the stale approval.
